finalText:
**Build's clean.** Exit 0, `0 errors`.

Two real bugs, not noise, both from the bump's options-shape change:

- [src/core/options.js](src/core/options.js) — `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw on `undefined.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- [src/net/retryPolicy.js](src/net/retryPolicy.js) — `isBackoffEnabled` threw on unset flags, since the new loader leaves them `undefined` instead of `false`. Now just checks `=== true`, unset defaults to disabled.

The rest is deprecation warnings (`Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, `punycode`, etc.) — harmless noise, left alone. Nothing left to do.
